ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Government Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the ways in which fraud schemes are able to occur in government programs and what steps can be taken to prevent them.
questions: How are fraud schemes able to occur in government programs?
What steps can be taken to prevent fraud in government programs?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability in government programs. I will use data analysis and investigative reporting techniques to follow the money and uncover the truth.
